title: ISO-NE .Z.WCMASS: day-ahead minus real-time by hour
subtitle: Mean spread for each local hour, 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-29, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: ISO-NE via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables isone_dam_zone_prices, isone_rtm_zone_prices; data retrieved to 2026-10-30.
citations: ISO New England (ISO-NE). Day-Ahead Energy Market Hourly LMPs. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `isone_dam_zone_prices`, ERW commit 75b92b7b4c20.
ISO New England (ISO-NE). Real-Time Energy Market Five-Minute LMPs. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `isone_rtm_zone_prices`, ERW commit 75b92b7b4c20.
facts: ISO-NE .Z.WCMASS, 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-29: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 19:00 local, 4.49 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 01:00, -1.13 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-10-23 to 2026-10-29: 2.13 USD/MWh.
